title: Weekend Agenda: Ben&Ben, Kim Soo-hyun, Gary V and more
summary: From Gary V’s return to the Music Museum and Ben&Ben’s big Araneta show to Shakespeare under the stars, plus cosplay and cocktails, there’s plenty to see, hear, taste and experience this weekend.
